    \addtogroup objdetect_aruco \{ /** \brief Dictionary is a set of unique ArUco markers of the same size bytesList storing as 2-dimensions Mat with 4-th channels (CV_8UC4 type was used) and contains the marker codewords where: - bytesList.rows is the dictionary size - each marker is encoded using nbytes = ceil(markerSize*markerSize/8.) bytes - each row contains all 4 rotations of the marker, so its length is 4*nbytes - the byte order in the bytesList[i] row: //bytes without rotation/bytes with rotation 1/bytes with rotation 2/bytes with rotation 3// So bytesList.ptr(i)[k*nbytes + j] is the j-th byte of i-th marker, in its k-th rotation.
